scope: Targeted original-method comparison only; not a new literature survey or MRI replication

sources.title: Group Sequence Policy Optimization
sources.access: Primary HTML methods read; no reproduction
sources.verified_method: Same-query normalized rewards; sequence likelihood ratio exponent1/response_length and sequence clipping. At on-policy ratio1 each token score gradient has the scalar advantage divided by response length. This scalar does not determine a parameter-space direction without token VJPs.

sources.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
sources.access: Primary HTML methods/discussion read; no reproduction
sources.verified_method: GRPO compares responses to the same query using a group baseline and standardized reward. The paper separates data source, verifier and gradient coefficient; its mathematical-task results do not establish MRI transfer.

sources.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
sources.access: Primary HTML Sections3.2-3.3 andAlgorithm1 read; no reproduction
sources.verified_method: Filters prompts whose sampled accuracy is0or1 and resamples to fill a batch; also changes token-level loss aggregation. A fixed-response conditional admission proposal shares a filtering ancestor but must explicitly differ in conditional criterion and absence of oversampling; it cannot claim filtering itself is new.

sources.title: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective
sources.access: Primary HTML Sections3.1-3.2 read; no reproduction
sources.verified_method: Analyzes response-length and question-level standard-deviation weighting; Dr.GRPO removes those normalization factors. This is a close precedent for normalization claims, not proof that changing GSPO sequence ratios is appropriate for MRI. We retain current GSPO unless an independently specified candidate explicitly changes it.

sources.title: mDPO: Conditional Preference Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Models
sources.access: Primary HTML Section3.1 method equation read; no experiment reproduction
sources.verified_method: CoPO compares the SAME chosen full response under a preferred versus less-compatible image using DPO reference ratios and a logistic preference objective. It also has a separate reward anchor. Matching an answer category across independently sampled MRI responses is weaker than holding the entire response fixed; it does not eliminate reasoning-text nuisance.
sources.comparison_boundary: Same-answer/different-image preference is a known conceptual precedent; not global novelty. An on-policy group-relative conditional baseline has a different estimator/objective and is not thereby proven superior or original.
sources.results_audit: No numerical performance or MRI transfer claim checked in this bounded methods comparison

sources.title: Spurious Advantage Hidden in GRPO
sources.access: Primary HTML Section3.1 and Section3.4 method read; no implementation/experiment reproduction
sources.verified_method: SignBalance keeps verifier signs, replaces composition-dependent magnitudes with a global scale and balances positive/negative reward classes. It treats guessing in bounded-answer tasks as a risk. This does not identify which of our MRI answers were guessed or provide anatomical evidence.
sources.comparison_boundary: Reward-sign balancing differs from grouping matched generated answer labels across true images. Neither literature similarity nor correct sign proves visual parameter-gradient improvement.
